name: rotid-phase1-boundaries
purpose: Phase 1 (test_rotating_ids on all four phones): epoch boundaries 15:45 and 16:00 IST, restart inside an epoch, a call S24 to M31 across the 15:45 boundary, passive-tracker view from ASUS and M31 controller-level capture.

phone_roles.ASUS: rotating browser, passive observer (controller-level capture full)

results.set_stop_at_boundary_ms: listener set stopped 8-25 ms after the boundary callback on every phone
results.restart_inside_epoch_keeps_rdi: A15s relaunched 15:41:33: RDI <id> unchanged, address <addr> -> <addr> (controller-level capture and observer logs); M31 relaunched 4 times in 14:53-14:59 (epoch 14:45-15:00): RDI <id> unchanged each time (phase1-callsetup)
results.zero_carry_over: No RDI and no advertising address (random type) seen in more than one epoch, in both observers (ASUS capture and M31 capture): epoch 1 RDIs <id> <id> <id> <id>; epoch 2 <id> <id> <id> <id>; epoch 3 <id> <id> <id> <id>. Inside epoch 2, <id> changed address <addr> -> <addr> at 15:58:31 (stack timer; linkable only through the same RDI). Check on the CSVs: 19 (ASUS) and 20 (M31) distinct RDI/address identifiers; none was reported on both sides (more than 3 s, observer clocks differ by up to 2 s) of either boundary.
results.bonded_identity_leak: App-level scan results of bonded phones (ASUS<->S24) show the identity address (S24 <addr>, ASUS <addr>) for the rotating RDIs; the HCI view shows RPAs.
results.call_across_boundary: S24 called M31 by RDI <id> at 15:43:23.6 (rotid_open PASS rdi=<id> prefix=<node:M31>), ACTIVE 15:43:27.3, ended by control at 15:48:02.6 (274 s) across the 15:45:00 boundary. Both phones had stopped their call listener sets when the call was accepted (15:43:23 / 15:43:27) and advertised again only at 15:48:04-06 on the new epoch RDIs: no advertising during a call.
results.link_survives_set_stop: PASS: call link carried ACTIVE for 274 s with the listener set stopped (n=1 call)
results.quick_stop_start: No set start failure logged in 9 observed restarts (silence 1.0-6.8 s) and 12 relaunches (3 s apart); sub-second restart not exercised: UNMEASURED

method: Manual measurement session (not a runner suite, no generated media input). Address and identifier values, raw logs and controller captures are not published; counts and timings are.
